planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@soply.test with password Soply123! (fill the Email and Password fields on /login and click 'Sign in')
Click 'Departments' in the Manage section of the sidebar
The page shows the heading 'Departments' and a note that departments are maintained at company level ('Departments are reference data maintained at company level')
Department cards are shown for Finance (with '4 members' and '6 published SOPs'), IT Operations, and People & Culture
Click the 'Browse SOPs' link on the Finance card
The SOP library opens filtered to the Finance department and shows published SOPs including 'Expense reimbursement'
